stories.label: Iran-US-Israel war begins: Khamenei killed, regional war erupts
stories.summary: US and Israel launched strikes on Iran Saturday morning. Iran retaliated with missiles and drones against Israel and four Gulf states hosting US military bases (Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar). An elementary school was struck; at least one child killed. The nuclear talks that started in Geneva have ended in open regional war.

stories.label: Khamenei killed: Iran in power vacuum after US-Israel joint strike
stories.summary: Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed Saturday in joint US-Israel strike, enabled by US real-time intelligence on his Tehran location. He was 86, led Iran since 1989. Reaction inside Iran split between celebration and grief. Assembly of Experts must convene to appoint successor. IRGC command and nuclear program status unclear.

stories.label: US intelligence shared Khamenei location with Israel, enabling strike
stories.summary: US officials disclosed Khamenei's location in Tehran to Israel, enabling the strike. This may violate Executive Order 12333 prohibiting assassination of foreign leaders. Strike appears to have been improvised around a fleeting intelligence window. Accountability for who authorised the disclosure remains unresolved.

stories.label: Elementary school struck in Iran: girl killed, war crimes accused
stories.summary: A strike on an elementary school in Iran killed at least one girl. An Iranian man was filmed cradling her remains, accusing Israel of war crimes. Schools are protected under international humanitarian law; striking them constitutes a potential war crime.

stories.label: Pakistan at UNSC: condemning both sides, 10 million nationals caught in Gulf
stories.summary: Pakistan condemned both US-Israel strikes on Iran and Iranian attacks on Gulf states at emergency UNSC session. Mentioned school children killed in Iran and a Pakistani national killed in UAE in the same statement. 10 million Pakistani workers in Gulf states face danger. UNSC ended without resolution.

stories.label: North Korea condemns Iran strikes: geopolitical bloc crystallising
stories.summary: North Korea called both the US military operation and Israel's attacks on Iran 'illegal aggression.' Signals alignment of Russia-North Korea-Iran bloc against US-led order. North Korea views killing of Khamenei as precedent for what could happen to Kim Jong-un — driving further nuclear entrenchment.

stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks Geneva — ENDED: talks collapsed into war
stories.summary: The Geneva nuclear talks framework is closed. US shared Khamenei's location with Israel while talks were active; he was killed March 1. The arc is now superseded by iran-us-israel-war.

stories.label: Syria three-front crisis — al-Hol mass escape adds to Assad remnant and IS threats
stories.summary: Syria fighting on three fronts: regime remnants in Latakia, IS insurgents in the east, and thousands of IS-linked families escaped from al-Hol. Iran war may now divert attention and resources from Syria — watch for IS to exploit the vacuum.

stories.label: Myanmar junta bombs Rakhine — war continues with minimal attention
stories.summary: Military air strikes killed 17 at a village market in Rakhine state. War continues under international radar, further obscured by Iran war.

stories.label: Zimbabwe bans all raw mineral and lithium exports
stories.summary: Zimbabwe imposed immediate ban on export of all raw minerals and lithium concentrate. Africa's largest lithium reserves. Chinese firms are primary buyers. Watch for industry response and implementation enforcement.

stories.label: Philippines EDSA 40th anniversary protests — Marcos Jr. faces democratic anger
stories.summary: Thousands protested corruption on 40th EDSA anniversary. Marcos Jr. faces same democratic anger as his father. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: Sickle cell gene therapy — $2.2M cure inaccessible where disease kills most
stories.summary: Casgevy gene therapy cures sickle cell but costs $2.2M per patient. 80% of cases in sub-Saharan Africa. Pharmaceutical inequality story — watch for access advocacy developments.

stories.label: FBI subpoenas X for Grok prompts used to create deepfake harassment videos
stories.summary: FBI obtained Grok AI prompts via subpoena to X. First known case of law enforcement using legal process to get AI prompts as evidence. Watch for court proceedings and broader precedent.

stories.label: US orders diplomats to fight data sovereignty initiatives worldwide
stories.summary: State Department ordered diplomats to oppose data localization laws worldwide. Affects India, Indonesia, Nigeria, Brazil. Watch for country responses — especially India.

stories.label: Sudan war — Hemedti linked to Dubai property portfolio, UNSC sanctions commanders
stories.summary: Not covered this cycle. UNSC sanctions follow-up, Hemedti Dubai property investigation still open. Iran war now dominates UNSC bandwidth.

stories.label: Pentagon vs Anthropic military AI — Feb 27 deadline outcome unknown
stories.summary: Feb 27 deadline has passed; no fresh story in the feed about outcome. May have been overtaken by Iran war coverage. Check next cycle for resolution.

stories.label: Pakistan multi-front crisis — border war, economic crash, terrorism
stories.summary: Not covered this cycle. Pakistan now also dealing with Iran war fallout — nationals killed in UAE, UNSC position. Economic and security crisis continues in background.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics execution-style
stories.summary: Forensic investigation found 900+ bullets fired at aid workers, 15 killed execution-style. CPJ: Israel killed 86 journalists in 2025. Now Iran war opens new front — Gaza operations may intensify.

stories.label: Israel orders 37 aid organizations to halt operations in Gaza
stories.summary: 37 aid groups ordered to halt operations. Aid groups petitioning Israeli court. Still uncovered — Iran war dominating bandwidth.

stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over 2019 Easter bombings
stories.summary: Former intelligence chief arrested over 2019 Easter Sunday bombings that killed 279. Seven years of impunity broken. Watch for trial proceedings.

stories.label: 6.5 million in Somalia face severe hunger as drought deepens
stories.summary: 6.5 million Somalis face severe hunger. Drought compounded by Al-Shabaab blocking aid and US funding freezes. Not covered this cycle.

stories.label: WiseTech cuts 2,000 jobs as AI replaces software engineers
stories.summary: WiseTech cutting one-third of workforce attributing layoffs to AI replacing coding. Watch for industry-wide response and regulatory attention.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — year 5 grinds on
stories.summary: No major development in this cycle. Iran war now dominates Russian foreign policy attention. Watch for Russia to exploit reduced US focus on Ukraine.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: Fading. Iran war will now reshape tariff dynamics — oil price spike, Gulf trade disruption, global recession risk. Watch for economic fallout of the war rather than tariff mechanics.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up death lists for drug war
stories.summary: Fading. ICC hearing moving into procedural phase.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Fading. Situation reportedly stabilized.
